description: Create an account (company) in Dynamics 365 Sales. Required: name. Optional: account_number, email, phone, website, street, postal_code, city, country, description, primary_contact_id, fields. Checks for an account with the same name first. WRITES into the customer's Dynamics 365 — it goes through the permission gate and the Dynamics write log (audit_log dynamics_write).

allow_duplicate.description: set only after a human confirmed that the found duplicate is a different record

fields.description: further Dataverse columns by logical name (lower case, e.g. {"address1_city":"Leipzig"}); lookups as {"parentaccountid@odata.bind":"/accounts(<GUID>)"}

name: create_dynamics_account
